workDescription: Additive migration 0005 (library_items, lesson_library_items); 4 new routes (POST /library, PATCH /library/:id, POST and DELETE /lessons/:id/library-items) in routes/library.ts; a fall-through library block in canAccessAttachment that widens GET /uploads/:id{,/download} only for files linked to the caller's non-cancelled lessons (or published items for managers); role-filtered libraryItems/lessonLibraryItems bootstrap keys (16 -> 18); frontend types, dual-branch services, permissions (library.manage, library.edit, lesson.attachLibraryItem), Library tab, Materials dialog, teacher/student materials lists. Step F (24-11-26): plan attach takes only { attachmentId } of an existing upload (uploader-or-admin, request evidence 422, never inserts attachments rows); downloads go through resolveUploadPath containment (404 + id-only log on escape); manager bootstrap no longer pulls other managers' user rows (createdByName for admin/manager); attach race retry-once-then-409; additive migration 0006 CHECK on library_items.status; strict status mapper.
approver: pending — reviewer (vc-code-reviewer or the user) records the decision in review-decision.json
why: Applies a migration to the shared dev database and changes who may download which files. A defect could expose one student's materials to another, re-open the Phase 02 request-evidence hole, or let teachers/students attach files. The migration is additive only (CREATE TABLE / CREATE INDEX / ADD CONSTRAINT); no existing table is altered.
